name: St Martin's Institute of Higher Education
summary: Private institute in Hamrun teaching in English since 1985; a University of London Recognised Teaching Centre for business and computing degrees.

ib.text: SMI states Maltese entry (Matriculation or A/I-level passes). International equivalents such as the IB are judged case by case by SMI and the University of London. Computing also needs Maths at SEC O level or equivalent.

lastYear.text: apply by 31 August (later at SMI's discretion)

programmes.name: Accounting and Finance
programmes.about: University of London degree developed by LSE academics (180 ECTS), covering the major issues of modern finance and accounting in theory and practice; SMI teaches it in person and UoL sets the exams.
programmes.ib: Ask SMI whether your IB results count; UoL decides international equivalents at its discretion.
programmes.selectionNote: Entry on qualifications; SMI also runs an applicant interview. First come, first served while places last.

programmes.name: Business Administration
programmes.about: University of London degree with academic direction from Royal Holloway: general business administration or a pathway in International Business or Marketing (SMI lists both pathways as degrees), taught in person at a teaching centre.
programmes.ib: Ask SMI whether your IB results count; UoL decides international equivalents at its discretion.
programmes.selectionNote: Entry on qualifications; SMI also runs an applicant interview. First come, first served while places last.

programmes.name: Computer Science
programmes.about: University of London degree in programming, mathematics and computing with a specialism such as machine learning and AI, games development or virtual reality; SMI lists these as separate degrees.
programmes.ib: Maths at SEC O level grade 1–3 or an equivalent is asked; SMI offers free bridging classes. Ask SMI about IB Maths.

needs.note: SMI asks for Maths at SEC O level grade 1–3 or equivalent

programmes.selectionNote: Entry on qualifications; SMI also runs an applicant interview. First come, first served while places last.

notes: SMI's own site lists more named degrees than these three: its own computing BSc (Hons) specialisms, Banking and Finance, and Business and Management; none has a page of its own, so ask SMI which run in 2027.

SMI says it confers qualifications at MQF Level 5 and that its Level 6 degrees are awarded by the University of London, which sets and marks the May examinations; the UoL pages show their own intake dates.

SMI charges a non-refundable €125 application fee; its tuition page says no fee is payable until you finish your degree through the Studies+ loan, and does not say whether University of London fees are included.
